k: A cage wrestler at an underground title bout
st: Bonesaw McGraw crushes challengers in a $3000 cage match until the masked Peter pins him in two minutes.

files.notes: Announced on screen as 'Bone Saw McGraw' by the ring announcer (transcript); credited spelling Bonesaw kept. The waiver read to Peter says the NYWL runs the event, but the screen never ties Bonesaw himself to it, so Independent. Filed as A: a sporting opponent, not a villain.

k: A Midtown High jock, Mary Jane's boyfriend
A former classmate of Peter and Harry
st: Flash picks a hallway fight with Peter, who knocks him flying, and Mary Jane dumps him after graduation.
Flash is among the mourners at Harry's funeral.

files.notes: Called Flash in the fight and 'Flash Thompson' by Uncle Ben (transcript); Eugene is never said, so not used. Filed as A like the app's other Flashes, a school bully rather than a threat. Midtown High is named on screen; he graduates, so Independent from Spider-Man 3. His Spider-Man 3 funeral appearance (no lines) rests on the MCU wiki page and its screenshot.

st: Mr. Balkan tells Norman he is out of Oscorp, and the Green Goblin kills him at the Unity Day festival.

files.notes: Only 'Mr. Balkan' is said (Norman's greeting); Henry is from the credits, so n is Mr. Balkan. 'You're out, Norman' is his line per the MCU wiki quote; the transcript has no speaker names. The wiki page calls him board chairman, which the screen does not state, so k says board member.

st: Max Fargas tells Norman the board is unanimous on selling Oscorp, and the Green Goblin kills him at the Unity Day festival.

files.notes: Norman calls him 'Mr. Fargas' and 'Max', and Harry greets him as Mr. Fargas at the festival (transcript); Maximillian is from the credits only, so n is Max Fargas. The 'board is unanimous' line is his per the MCU wiki quote.

k: Norman Osborn's lead scientist at Oscorp
st: Dr. Stromm warns the performance enhancers are unstable, then helps Norman test them on himself, and the crazed Norman kills him.

files.notes: Named 'Dr. Stromm' at the board review and in the news of his murder (transcript); Mendel is not said, so n is Dr. Stromm. The killing is shown and the morning news confirms he was murdered in the lab.

k: A general weighing Oscorp's military contract
st: General Slocum threatens to move Oscorp's funding to Quest Aerospace, and dies when a glider rider bombs the Quest test.

files.notes: Named by Norman and at the Quest test ('General Slocum', transcript). Group: he is a general and the screen names Oscorp's customer as the United States military; app spelling U.S. Military used, though his branch is never said. The funding threat is attributed to him by the MCU wiki and the reviewer; the transcript has no speaker names. Filed as A (victim) since he never works against the heroes.

st: Henry helps May pack for her move and asks Peter where Spider-Man has gone, and May says kids like him need a hero.

files.notes: Named in full by May (transcript). No group named on screen: Independent.

st: Mr. Aziz gives the always late Peter one last chance to deliver on time, then fires him when he is late again.

files.notes: Peter calls him 'Mr. Aziz' twice (transcript); the first name Rahi is credits only. Joe's Pizza is said ('Joe's 29-minute guarantee') and on the sign.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Peter signs up for Bonesaw McGraw's cage match to win $3000 and is announced as the Amazing Spider-Man. Bonesaw mocks and pounds him, but Peter pins him in two minutes.
stages.whoA: The masked newcomer who pins him in a cage match
stages.whoB: Bonesaw McGraw, the wrestler he beats for prize money

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Flash laughs at Peter from the school bus and, after a tray of food hits him, starts a hallway fight. Peter, newly powered, dodges his punches and sends him flying across the hall.
stages.whoA: Peter, the classmate who knocks him down
stages.whoB: Flash, the school bully he beats in a fight

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Flash is Mary Jane's boyfriend and takes her for a ride in his new car. After graduation she hands back his ring and leaves him.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, his girlfriend until graduation
stages.whoB: Flash, the boyfriend she leaves at graduation

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Mr. Balkan sits on the Oscorp board that reviews Norman's work. When the board sells the company, he tells Norman he is out, and the Green Goblin kills him at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Norman, the founder he forces out, and his killer
stages.whoB: Mr. Balkan, a board member who ousts him

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Mr. Balkan and Max Fargas visit Oscorp together as board members and vote to sell the company. Both die when the Green Goblin attacks the board at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Max Fargas, a fellow board member
stages.whoB: Mr. Balkan, a fellow board member

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Max Fargas tells Norman the board is unanimous on selling Oscorp and forcing him out. Days later the Green Goblin kills him at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Norman, the founder he ousts, and his killer
stages.whoB: Max Fargas, the board member who ousts him

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: At the Unity Day festival Harry asks Max Fargas if he has seen his father. Moments later the Green Goblin attacks the board.
stages.whoA: Harry, Norman's son, who greets him at the festival
stages.whoB: Mr. Fargas, an Oscorp board member

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Dr. Stromm runs Norman's performance enhancer work at Oscorp and warns it must go back to formula. Under pressure he helps Norman test it on himself, and the crazed Norman kills him.
stages.whoA: Norman, his boss, who kills him
stages.whoB: Dr. Stromm, his lead scientist, whom he kills

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: General Slocum visits Oscorp and threatens to give Norman's military contract to Quest Aerospace. When Quest tests its exoskeleton, a glider rider bombs the test and kills him.
stages.whoA: Norman, the contractor he threatens, and his killer
stages.whoB: General Slocum, who threatens his contract

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Henry Jackson, the boy across the street, helps May pack for her move for $5. May tells Peter that Henry wants to be Spider-Man and that kids like him need a hero.
stages.whoA: Mrs. Parker, the neighbor he helps move
stages.whoB: Henry Jackson, the boy who helps her pack

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Henry greets Peter at May's house and asks where Spider-Man has gone. Peter says he quit, and May's speech about Henry needing a hero moves him.
stages.whoA: Peter, May's nephew who takes Spider-Man's pictures

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Mr. Aziz scolds Peter for always being late and gives him one last chance to deliver eight pizzas in minutes. When Peter arrives late, Aziz fires him.
stages.whoB: Mr. Aziz, his boss at Joe's Pizza

changes.was: Bonesaw McGraw dares anyone to last three minutes with him for $3000, and the masked Peter pins him in two.
changes.now: Bonesaw McGraw crushes challengers in a $3000 cage match until the masked Peter pins him in two minutes.
changes.why: The $3000, three-minute challenge is issued by the ring announcer, not Bonesaw; Bonesaw beats the Flying Dutchman, then Peter pins him in two minutes.
